title: Lever Jobs - Live Metadata and Published Salaries

boards.title: Lever board slugs
boards.description: For jobs.lever.co/spotify enter spotify. Enter up to 25 board slugs; no automatic company discovery.

region.title: Lever hosting region
region.description: Global for jobs.lever.co; EU for jobs.eu.lever.co. All boards in a run use the same region.

titleContains.title: Title contains
titleContains.description: Optional case-insensitive literal text filter. Applied before billing.

locationContains.title: Location contains
locationContains.description: Optional case-insensitive literal text filter over all published locations.

workplaceType.title: Workplace type
workplaceType.description: Filter on the source field. Unknown values never qualify as remote.

maxItems.title: Maximum results
maxItems.description: Maximum unique records saved and billed across this run.

pageSize.title: Source page size
pageSize.description: At most 100 source records per request; also capped by maxItems.

maxPages.title: Maximum source pages
maxPages.description: Stop after this many pages, even if filters find fewer results. Includes empty pages.

requestDelaySeconds.title: Request interval (seconds)
requestDelaySeconds.description: Minimum interval between all requests. A longer robots.txt delay takes precedence.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Off by default. Optional Apify Proxy requires your Apify account configuration. Proxies never override robots.txt or access restrictions.
